Truckee Fire Protection District                                                         Board of Directors
                                                                                                                                 Gary R. Botto
                                 Proudly providing service to portions of both Nevada and

The Truckee Fire Protection District will meet in Regular Session on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 in the
Truckee Sanitary District Boardroom located at 12304 Joerger Drive Truckee, California at 5:30 p.m.
The Board may take action on any item appearing on the Agenda unless specifically identified as “Discussion Only” or “Informational Only”. The Board
will not take action on any item not appearing on the Agenda except as permitted by Government Code section 54954.2.

                                                                      AGENDA
1. Call Meeting to Order.
2. Roll Call.
3. Pledge of Allegiance.
4. Clear the Agenda.
5. PRESENTATION:
      A. The Committee to Incorporate North Tahoe.                                                                                     Attachment 1


6. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
     Members of the public shall be allowed to address the Board of Directors on items not appearing on the agenda that are of interest to the public and are
     within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board, provided that no action shall be taken unless otherwise authorized by California Government Code
     Section 54954.2. Each speaker will be limited to one (1) appearance and be limited to three (3) minutes, but speaker time may be reduced at the
     discretion of the Board Chair if there are a large number of speakers on any given subject. There shall be no assignment of speaking time from one
     member of the public to another member of the public. The same procedures shall apply to public comment on matters that are on the agenda.


7. CONSENT CALENDAR:
     These items are expected to be routine and non-controversial. The Board will act upon them at one time without discussion. Any Board member, staff
     member or interested party may request that an item be removed from the consent calendar for discussion.
     A. Approval of the September 15, 2026 Regular Board Meeting Minutes.
     B. Approval of the September 10, 2026 Finance Committee Meeting Minutes.
     C. Approval of the September 24, 2026 Finance Committee Meeting Minutes.
     D. Check Register – September 2026.
     E. Fund Balance – September 2026.
     F. Balance Sheets – September 2026.
     G. LAIF Fund Report - September 2026.
     H. TFPD Organizational Chart.
     I. Training Reports – September 2026.                                                                                             Attachment 2
8. STAFF REPORTS:
     A. Chief’s Report.                                                                                                                Attachment 3
     B. Operations Division Chief’s Report.                                                                                            Attachment 4
     C. Fire Marshal’s Report.                                                                                                         Attachment 5
     D. Finance Director Report.                                                                                                       Attachment 6
     E. Wildfire Prevention Manager Report.                                                                                            Attachment 7

9. COMMITTEE REPORTS:
     A. Measure T Citizens’ Oversight Committee (COC).
     B. Fire Protection Funding from Annexation No. 7 Ad Hoc Committee.

10. OLD BUSINESS:
    A. Station 90 Progress Update.                                                                                                                          Attachment 8
11. NEW BUSINESS:
      A. Discussion with Possible Action: Award and Contract Services for the Pine
         Forest-Coachland Fuel Reduction Project.
         1. Staff Report.                                                                                                                                   Attachment 9
         2. Bid Opening Report.                                                                                                                             Attachment 10
         3. Draft Contract for Services.                                                                                                                    Attachment 11
      B. Discussion with Possible Action: Prosser Dam Road Fire Mitigation Project
         Grant Amendment.
         1. Staff Report.                                                                                                                                   Attachment 12
         2. Amendment Request Letter.                                                                                                                       Attachment 13
      C. Discussion with Possible Action: Fleet Chief Vehicle Replacement.                                                                                  Attachment 14
      D. Discussion with Possible Action: TFPD’s Facility Condition Assessment.                                                                             Attachment 15

12. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS:
      A. Insurance Accessibility Recognition Award.                                                                                                         Attachment 16
             B. Appreciation Email for Wildfire Prevention.                                                                                                 Attachment 17
             C. Appreciation Email of Truckee Elementary Defensible Space Stewardship Day.                                                                  Attachment 18


13. CLOSED SESSION: No items.
        The Ralph M. Brown Act (Government Code sections 54950-54963) regulates Closed Sessions in Sections 54956.7 through 54957.2. Some, but not
        all, of the permissible items that may be discussed in closed session are threatened or pending litigation, specified employee matters, real property
        negotiations and threats to facilities, public or national security. A public report of any action taken in Closed Sessions is usually required at the
        conclusion of the Closed Session, including a report of the vote or abstention of any member present at that Closed Session.

14. RETURN TO OPEN SESSION: No items.

15. BOARD COMMUNICATIONS
16. ADJOURNMENT
Until further notice Agenda Packets with any attachments are available for public review on the Truckee Fire Protection District website;
www.truckeefire.org. Any documents provided to the Board during the meeting will be available for public review by email request after the meeting to:
monicaskov@truckeefire.org.

Posted and delivered on October 16, 2026
Monica Skov Administrative Assistant / Clerk of the Board
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the District at (530) 582-7850. Notification
two business days before the meeting should enable the District to make reasonable accommodations to ensure accessibility to the meeting.
